FIELDS.NAME: Pedal Power Bicycle Shop
FIELDS.CONTACT FOR INSPECTION: John Smith, Operations Manager, Pedal Power Bicycle Shop, (555) 123-4567, john.smith@pedalpower.com
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: Pedal Power Bicycle Shop specializes in the retail sale of bicycles and accessories, offering a wide range of models to meet the needs of cyclists of all levels. Our operations include sales of new bicycles, bike accessories, and apparel, as well as professional bicycle repair and maintenance services performed by trained technicians. We prioritize customer satisfaction and safety, ensuring that all repairs are conducted to a high standard. Our physical storefront is equipped with security measures like alarm systems and surveillance cameras to protect our inventory, which further demonstrates our commitment to providing a secure shopping experience. We operate in compliance with all local, state, and federal regulations and maintain comprehensive liability insurance to safeguard our business and customers. Our focus remains solely on product sales and customer service. Our staff is well-trained in bicycle mechanics, reinforcing our commitment to quality service and safety while adhering to all operational guidelines.
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: On 06/15/2023, a customer accidently damaged an expensive bicycle by dropping it during a test ride, resulting in a repair cost of $500. The claim has been settled and resolved.
FIELDS.SAFE/VAULT DETAILS: Class III safe, UL-Listed, with a fire rating of 1 hour and a viewing window for security monitoring.
FIELDS.OTHER PROTECTION: Fencing and surveillance cameras for enhanced security.
